### Borea v0.2.0-dev.2: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.2.0 before it is released.
It is not for playing. For normal use, stay on v0.1.0.
v0.2.0 follows in a few days.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test the update

This is the first release that v0.2.0-dev.1 can update to by itself.
In dev.1, use "Update now" on the Home banner, or `borea update-self`, and tell us whether Borea restarts as dev.2 in the same folder.

#### New since v0.2.0-dev.1

- Discover: each Game version box has its own X that clears only that bound.
- Discover: a chosen license or operating system is marked in the side panel, and a second click removes it again.
- Discover: the chips of many active filters wrap onto more lines instead of running past the edge.
- Mod page: the installed version no longer offers "+" on the Versions tab.
- Mod authors: the page is now called "List or change your mod". "Change a listed mod" finds a listing by name, id or author, shows each author, loads a result with a double click, and puts your own listings first when you are signed in to GitHub.
- The listing page has the back arrow of the other pages.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on, and the change takes effect at the next start.
When v0.2.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
